workspaceRelease.title: Release environment
workspaceRelease.intro: Release this closed chat's entire compute environment and disk to free its resource quota. Preview the scope and confirm the data loss first.
workspaceRelease.retained: Chat history, saved file snapshots and Return records are retained. This operation cannot be undone.
workspaceRelease.wholeEnvironment: Deleting the disk removes all working directories, imported directories, staged content, uncommitted and untracked files in this environment. Processes are also lost.
workspaceRelease.snapshotBoundary: A file snapshot covers only the directories selected when it was created, not the entire disk. Return records are retained, but cannot reactivate a released disk. A saved snapshot can be restored separately.
workspaceRelease.capability: Release is currently available only for Kubernetes environments that can verify physical resource and storage deletion. Docker and E2B do not offer this release operation.
workspaceRelease.lossScope: The entire environment disk will be deleted, affecting {count} workspaces.
workspaceRelease.retainedCount: Chat history, {snapshots} saved snapshots and {returns} Return records are retained. They may not cover every file.
workspaceRelease.lossAcceptance: I confirm release of the entire environment and accept permanent loss of every file and process state not saved in a snapshot.
workspaceRelease.unknownHint: Release is pending or its result is unconfirmed. Check the original operation; deletion will not be sent again.
workspaceRelease.releasedHint: The original resources and disk have been verified as released. Chat history and saved snapshots remain. Continuing execution creates a new environment.
workspaceRelease.unsupported: This environment does not support verified release, or the service has not enabled it. The original environment is retained.
workspaceRelease.blocked: Execution, a workspace switch or a file operation is still active. Complete or check the original operation before creating a new preview.
workspaceRelease.scopeChanged: The workspace or environment has changed, so this preview cannot proceed. Check the retained operation record.
workspaceRelease.authorityBlocked: Current authorization or execution identity cannot be verified. Release was blocked; ask an administrator to check its state.
workspaceRelease.notFound: No operation record was found for this account.
workspaceRelease.unavailable: The operation result is temporarily unavailable. Keep this record and check again later.
